messages:
Amelia R.: Quick heads up — Tara M.'s final pay (run 2024-03-18) shows employer HSA deposit $500 credited, but employee pretax deduction $125 wasn't deducted from taxable wages. Paystub screenshot attached. Can payroll confirm if the HSA deferral was skipped? This will affect Box 12 on W-2 and Box 1 taxable wages.

Jason (Payroll): Can you drop employee ID and the pay period? I can pull the run logs.

Amelia R.: Sure — Tara Morales, employee ID 20987, pay period 03/01/2024-03/15/2024, final pay run 2024-03-18.

Priya (Benefits): Looking at Benefit Enrollment — Tara elected HSA 3/01 and employer contribution kicked in. Election status shows active at 03/01.

Payroll Bot: payroll run 2024-03-18 completed. run_id: `RUN-20240318-13` status: success.

Jason (Payroll): I pulled RUN-20240318-13. There's a manual benefit reversal entry on 03/18 09:12 by user `hr_ops_admin` that zeroed the employee deferral line before finalization. Employer credit still processed.

Amelia R.: @Jason that sounds like the cause. Did HR ops make a retro election change?

Priya (Benefits): We had one admin update to correct a double-enroll glitch, but that change shouldn't remove a valid election. I'm checking the transaction notes now. :eyes:

Tara M.: Hi — I did update elections accidentally when I was reviewing changes. I thought my HSA stayed on. Sorry about the confusion. Happy to sign anything required to fix.

Jason (Payroll): Plan: 1) open contractor/vendor ticket with ADP to run an off-cycle correction to collect missed employee pre-tax $125 and reconfirm employer $500; 2) update YTD taxable wages to reflect corrected pre-tax deduction; 3) if W-2 already filed at year-end we'd issue W-2c. For now, we'll schedule off-cycle payroll.

Priya (Benefits): Agreed — prefer off-cycle so the deduction posts as pretax (not post-tax). If we instead collect next regular pay, payroll must apply it as pretax and not reverse taxable wages.

Amelia R.: Please CC payroll@redwood and copy Tara so she's in the loop. Also note for the audit log: admin change came from `hr_ops_admin` on 03/18 09:11.

Jason (Payroll): Ticket created: `ADP-8421`. Off-cycle scheduled 2024-03-25. I'll paste completion notes here when done.

Payroll Bot: ticket ADP-8421 created and assigned to Payroll Ops.

Amelia R.: Thanks — please confirm whether we need a retro 941 adjustment or other tax filings if this changes deposited taxes for the quarter.

Jason (Payroll): Good call. I'll have payroll tax team estimate impact. Likely minimal for one hire, but we'll confirm and log for the quarter close.

Priya (Benefits): I'll also verify employer contribution code mapping to Box 12 (code: `W`) and ensure correct reporting.

Tara M.: Thanks everyone. Appreciate the quick help.

Jason (Payroll): Off-cycle completed 2024-03-25 11:03 ET. Collected $125 pretax and reconciled employer $500. Updated YTD taxable wages. No W-2 change needed yet; will monitor year-end. Closing ticket ADP-8421. :white_check_mark:
